1	# Usage permission fix: verification brief
2	
3	Read first: `/home/mini/Documents/repos/Farhan/research/agent-rules-2026-11-20.md`.
4	Worktree: `/home/mini/Documents/repos/Farhan.worktrees/usage-permission`, branch `fix/usage-permission-package`, base `717faf6`. The fix is applied and uncommitted (`git diff`).
5	Report file: `research/usage-permission-report.md`. Boat run name: `usage-permission`.
6	
7	## The bug (owner, 2026-11-20)
8	
9	"The usage page does not work, no matter how many times I grant or re-grant the permission."
10	
11	Cause found: `UsageRepositoryImpl.checkUsagePermission()` called `AppOpsManager.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow("android:get_usage_stats", Process.myUid(), "ly.com.tahaben.farhan")`
12	but the installed application id is `ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha` (`app/build.gradle.kts`: namespace `ly.com.tahaben.farhan`, applicationId `ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha`). AppOps refuses a package that
13	is not the uid's, so the check was never `MODE_ALLOWED`. The diff makes it use `context.packageName`, and does the same for the "ignore Farhan" filters in `UsageOverviewViewModel` and `WidgetWorker`
14	(they compared against the namespace string, so "ignore Farhan's own usage" never matched). The ViewModel gains an `@ApplicationContext` constructor parameter; `UsageOverviewE2E` constructs it.
15	
16	## Your job
17	
18	1. Review the diff for correctness and anything missed: grep the whole repo (all modules, `src/main` and tests) for other uses of the namespace string as if it were the package name (`"ly.com.tahaben.farhan"`); note legitimate uses (class names such as `Class.forName("ly.com.tahaben.farhan.MainActivity")` are fine).
19	2. Build and run the usage modules' unit tests and compile the `:app` androidTest sources: `:usage_overview:usage_overview_domain:test :usage_overview:usage_overview_presentation:testDebugUnitTest :app:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin` (adjust task names to what exists).
20	3. Prove it on the emulator, before and after. Baseline APK (built from this base, before the fix): sandbox path `/home/user/runs/farhan-notification-pilot/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`. Build the fixed APK from this worktree (`:app:assembleDebug`). Start the emulator (see rules), then:
21	   - install the baseline, `adb shell appops set ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha GET_USAGE_STATS allow`, open the app, tap Usage: record that the "permission not granted" content shows (the bug);
22	   - install the fixed APK (`adb install -r`), same appops state, open Usage: record that the usage page itself shows;
23	   - `adb shell appops get ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha GET_USAGE_STATS` both times.
24	   Capture screenshots (`adb exec-out screencap -p`) and the uiautomator text. Use `settings_rescue/emulator/ui.py` helpers.
25	4. If everything holds, commit on the branch with a message that explains the cause. Do not add tests that merely restate the change; the check is Android-bound. If you can extract a tiny pure seam that a JVM test would prove (a mock-free reason), say so in the report rather than building it.
26	Stop when verified, committed and reported.

# Emulator checks for the ADB helper

These scripts drive the helper end to end against an Android emulator's own wireless-debugging daemon: they open
Settings, read the pairing code, type it into the helper, check access, export Farhan's settings, or pull any
debuggable app's files and save the archive through the document picker. They exist because the helper cannot be
tested by unit tests alone: the daemon, TLS and `run-as` behaviour only show up on a real Android.

Needs: an API 30+ emulator (a `default` AOSP image works; the checks ran on API 35 x86_64), `adb` on `PATH` (or set
`ADB`), `python3`, and the helper and the target app installed. Run from this directory.

| Script | Does |
|---|---|
| `flow.py` | Pairs the helper (reuses an open pairing dialog) and presses Check access. Clears a leftover pending backup first. |
| `export.py` | Ticks the confirmation and presses Stop Farhan and export; prints the review text. |
| `pull.py <package>` | Sets the package and presses Pull raw files; prints the result. |
| `save.py` | Presses Save archive and confirms the document picker; prints the final screen. |
| `tlsadb.py <port> '<service>'` | Minimal wireless-ADB client, for checking a daemon without the helper: `adb forward tcp:41999 tcp:<connect port>` then `python3 tlsadb.py 41999 'exec:id -u'`. |
| `ui.py` | Shared helpers; run it alone to print the visible controls. |

The helper has to be shown beside Settings (the pairing dialog closes when Settings leaves the screen): the scripts
start it with `am start --windowingMode 5` (a freeform window), after
`settings put global enable_freeform_support 1` and `force_resizable_activities 1`.

An emulator daemon reports `auth not required` (its build is not `ro.adb.secure=1`), so these runs prove pairing,
TLS, streams and extraction, but not that a real phone accepts the helper's key. That needs the phone.

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def adb(*a, check=True):

def dump():

def nodes():

        m = re.match(r"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]", n.get("bounds", ""))
